_doc: subject = the command (Bash/PowerShell) or the file_path (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit).
pattern / unless / cwd are case-insensitive regexes; unless is tested against subject + cwd.
action: deny = Claude must ask you in chat first (works in every permission mode); ask = permission prompt.
check: {cmd, deny_if_exit, timeout} runs a shell probe; the rule fires only when the exit code matches,
so a 'players online' script can gate a rule. enabled:false parks a rule.
